login.title: Sign in to {{name}}
login.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured yet. Please contact your administrator.

devLogin.title: Development login
devLogin.description: Only available in local development and tests.
devLogin.noUsers: No users yet. Run php artisan db:seed to create sample users.

acknowledgment.title: Before you start
acknowledgment.intro: {{institution}} provides this AI assistant. Please read how it works:
acknowledgment.point1: Answers are generated by AI and can be wrong or incomplete. Check important information.
acknowledgment.point2: Your messages are sent to external AI providers to generate answers.
acknowledgment.point3: Do not enter personal data of others, passwords or confidential information.
acknowledgment.point4: Your conversations are private: administrators see usage and costs, not what you wrote.

landing.title: Your institution's AI assistant
landing.lead: Chat with today's leading AI models using your {{institution}} account. No separate password and no personal subscription: {{institution}} provides {{name}} and carries the cost.

models.title: Many models, one place
models.text: Models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, chosen by your institution. Attach files, search the web and use the institution's assistants.

budget.title: A monthly budget for everyone
budget.text: Each person gets a fair monthly budget. You always see what you have used, and you are warned before it runs out.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.text: Your conversations are yours: administrators cannot read them. Only what you choose to share is visible to others.

landing.footer: {{name}} is open source and hosted by {{institution}}.
